poses.name: tpose
poses.title: T-pose
poses.description: Standard T-pose used in many motion capture and animation retargeting pipelines.

poses.name: benchmark
poses.title: Benchmark-pose
poses.description: Benchmark pose used to test the rigging in extreme condition

poses.name: abducted
poses.title: Abducted
poses.description: Both legs swung out about 40° from the hips, the stance at its widest a body holds without a step. The check for the hip's volume lost where the thighs part.

poses.name: bent
poses.title: Bent
poses.description: Every hinge about half way: elbows flexed to about 90°, knees to about 80°, wrists bent about 35° (the left one way, the right the other), the hips raised 20°, the ankles bent back so the soles stay level. Open enough to see the crook of each joint, where its skin folds; the check for joint creases.

poses.name: flexed
poses.title: Flexed
poses.description: Every hinge joint near its extreme: elbows flexed about 140° and knees about 125°, hips raised 60°, wrists bent about 50° (the left to one side, the right to the other). The check for volume lost where skinning folds a limb.

poses.name: relaxed
poses.title: Relaxed
poses.description: Standing at ease: arms down at the sides about 9° from the body, elbows bent about 17°, forearms a little forward, hands beside the thighs.

poses.name: twisted
poses.title: Twisted
poses.description: Each limb twisted about its own axis, past what a body can: upper arms 110°, forearms (at the wrist) 170° and thighs 60°, mirrored right to left. The check for the candy-wrapper collapse of linear blend skinning.
